description:
s26 and s27. DO NOT build a new Vim engine. Reuse kopitiam-neovim's core, text and editor layers and its Rope buffer; add a small egui frontend/adapter -- do NOT embed Ratatui in the GUI. kopitiam-neovim is published (0.2.4).

kopitiam-neovim must stay ignorant of PDFs, page numbers, Kovan artifacts, classifications, bibliography semantics, provenance and synchronisation -- it is the TEXT EDITOR layer only.

MOUSE-FRIENDLY MODAL EDITING (s27), so Kovan stays usable by non-Vim users: clicking editable text moves the cursor there AND ENTERS INSERT MODE; support wheel scroll, drag selection, visible mode indication, Esc to Normal. Do NOT change standalone kvim semantics to achieve this -- it is Kovan's adapter's behaviour.

REPLACES src/digitiser/gui/desktop/markdown_editor.rs (274 lines).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: src/digitiser/gui/desktop/kvim_editor.rs (KvimEditorState), added kopitiam-neovim 0.2.4 dependency. Wraps kopitiam_neovim::editor::Editor directly -- the whole modal-editing engine (buffer, cursor, Normal/Insert/Visual/OperatorPending/Command modes, motions, operators, undo/redo) is reused unchanged; this module adds only the missing half: mapping egui::Event (Text + Key, incl. ctrl-chords) onto kopitiam_neovim::editor::key::Key, and painting buffer/cursor/selection/mode into an egui::Ui via ui.painter() + font metrics (no ratatui embedded, per s26). Mouse-friendly modal editing (s27), implemented as THIS ADAPTER's behaviour, not a kvim semantics change: click moves cursor + sends synthetic Esc-then-i to enter Insert; drag sends 'v' (charwise Visual, anchored at press) then extends via move_cursor as the drag continues -- composes with the engine's own selection tracking rather than reimplementing it; wheel scroll is the surrounding ScrollArea's, free; mode label always shown via Mode::label(). Wired as a new View::KvimEditor tab (kept ALONGSIDE the existing View::MarkdownEditor rather than replacing it outright -- that one still serves the working project.rs model, s3's MIGRATE, not yet done; swapping this in as the literal Research-workspace editor is op-9vo6.18's SyncController job). load_text()/text()/is_modified() are the seam a PaperSession will drive once that wiring lands. 9 tests (round-trip, modified-tracking, and the full egui-event-mapping table incl. the ctrl-chord case and the 'plain letters arrive via Text not Key' non-double-handling case).

title: kovan redesign 17: kopitiam-neovim editor engine + egui adapter

description: foam::write_polymesh(mesh, dir) (feature foam-export) wrapping to_poly_mesh + PolyMesh::write, so a generated VolumeMesh writes to a real OpenFOAM constant/polyMesh directory (runnable case). Round-trip test: write cartesian box -> PolyMesh::read -> counts/volume match. Plus an msr_channels example: a cylindrical vessel (outer cylinder surface) with internal cylindrical channels -> carve_around -> salt region mesh, completing the PBR/LWR/MSR reactor trilogy. V&V: disk round-trip counts; MSR example meshes + solvable.
title: cfmesh: OpenFOAM polyMesh disk writer + MSR channel example
